facts.fact: The UGPE of Cabo Verde's Finance Ministry issued an international invitation for bids on 29 July 2026 for supply, installation of facilities equipment and training for the Cabo Verde Technology Park Phase II, financed by the African Development Bank.
facts.system: Cabo Verde Technology Park (CVTP) Phase II
